steps.say: The Earth has layers. From the outside in, they are the crust, mantle, outer core and inner core.
steps.show: crust, mantle, outer core, inner core

steps.say: The crust is thin solid rock. The mantle is hot rock that flows very slowly.
The core is made of iron and nickel. The outer core is liquid, and the inner core is solid because of huge pressure.
The crust is broken into tectonic plates. They move a few centimetres each year.
Where plates meet, there are earthquakes and volcanoes. Indonesia sits where several plates meet.

figure.alt: A volcano and a mountain, formed where tectonic plates meet.

steps.say: Molten rock underground is called magma. When it erupts, it is called lava.
In an earthquake, drop, cover and hold on. On the coast, move to high ground in case of a tsunami.

check.prompt: Which layer of the Earth do we live on?

options.why: The mantle is below the crust.
The outer core is deep inside the Earth.
The inner core is at the very centre.

hints: We live on the outermost layer.
It is a thin layer of solid rock.
Think about the layer that is like the shell of an egg.
check.explanation: We live on the crust, the thin outer layer of solid rock.

check.prompt: Molten rock that is still underground is called ___.
hints: Molten rock has a different name when it reaches the surface.
On the surface, molten rock is called lava.
This word has five letters and starts with the letter m.
check.explanation: Molten rock underground is magma. Once it erupts onto the surface, it is called lava.
